items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: And his sister, they named his sister, Mac T-Girl.

ctx.x: How did you get the name of T-Boy too?

How did you get the name of T-Boy? Well, I tell you, my cousin, first cousin was named Mac Boy. And his sister, they named his sister, Mac T-Girl. So, they named my sister, this one here, T-Girl. Then they named me T-Boy. That was nicknames, you know. T-Boy, T-Girl, Mac Boy, Mac T-Girl. That's how I got the name.
Does it mean anything? How? Does it mean anything? Is it tea? Is it tea you drink?
